desc: Ideation and derivation of the transformed boundary DP that removes the explicit segment-index dimension.
Implement the O(n^2) boundary DP using prefix sums and the edge weight `P[j] * (C[j] - C[i]) + k * (C[n] - C[i])`.
Test the implementation on the provided examples and edge cases such as `n = 1`, one segment, and multiple cuts; optionally validate against brute force for small arrays.
